description: POI - Points Of Interest is a dataset listed in transportdata.be, a national access point for transport data, published or maintained by NGI - IGN. This dataset contains a set of Points Of Interest (POI) indicating the location of places of interest in Belgium, collected by NGI. The dataset consists of 97 POI types grouped into 6 classes (natural elements, cult elements, patrimonial elements, elements of general interest, infrastructures, economy). Coverage: Belgium (see the dataset page for the exact area). The portal lists 1 resource in MSG_HTTP. The data standards named are other. The national access point types are MMTIS. The portal shows 2025-05-09 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is cc-nc. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support mobility and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-transportdata-be-national-access-point.
